specific_waiting.value: 24 months of continuous coverage (cataract, hernia, BPH, joint replacement)

room_rent.value: Single Private A/C Room or any room category up to Sum Insured; ICU at actuals with no proportionate deduction

copay.value: No mandatory co-payment in base policy

maternity.value: Covered after 24 months waiting period up to ₹1,00,000 per delivery

ayush.value: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in a registered AYUSH Hospital covered up to 100% of Sum Insured

daycare.value: Day care procedures and Robotic surgeries covered up to 100% of Base Sum Insured

ncb.value: 20% Cumulative Bonus per claim-free year up to 100% of Base Sum Insured

renewal.value: 30 days Grace Period for renewal with continuity benefits

sublimits.value: No sub-limit on Cataract or Robotic surgery; Maternity up to ₹1,00,000
